name: moonrepo
description: moonrepo multi-language workspace: task runner, project graph, toolchain, and cached builds.
must: Run tasks through moon (`moon run <project>:<task>`) so the project graph and build cache are used.
Give every project tasks in `moon.yml` (or inherit them from `.moon/tasks.*`), with explicit `inputs` and `outputs` for deterministic caching.
Make the first git commit before running moon tasks in a new repo, and install pinned tool versions with `moon setup`.
never: Commit `.moon/cache/` directories or temporary build artifacts.
docs: https://moonrepo.dev/docs — official moon documentation (match it to `moon --version`). Read it before changing .moon/ configs or tasks.
`moon mcp` — moon's official MCP server for AI agents (projects, tasks, affected files).
`moon <command> --help` — check CLI syntax and flags before executing.
